youtubeTitle: Meet Poseidon & Echo: Aquarium Guidance Made Simple
youtubeDescription: Explore how Poseidon guides you through your aquarium journey. Meet Echo, your casual-mode companion, evolving alongside your progress. A quick look at features that keep your experience smooth and connected.

beats.onScreen: App logo animates into Poseidon AI interface; Echo drifts by casually.
beats.narration: Welcome to Aquacellum. Here, Poseidon and Echo help you navigate the depths of aquarium care.

beats.onScreen: Poseidon AI interface overlay opens over an active tank view.
beats.narration: Poseidon is your global assistant. Always floating, always reachable. Whether you're in casual or pro mode, it's there to guide you.

beats.onScreen: User toggles Poseidon AI on and off in the settings menu.
beats.narration: You can toggle Poseidon in your settings. Keep it active when you need real-time help.

beats.onScreen: Echo floats gently near the dashboard in casual mode.
beats.narration: If you're in casual mode, Echo joins you. A quiet companion with gentle nudges and rare animations.

beats.onScreen: Echo subtly whispers a proactive nudge to the user.
beats.narration: Echo evolves as you progress. From Shallow to Hadal, it mirrors your growth and becomes more dynamic over time.

beats.onScreen: XP bar and tier badge update as the user earns points.
beats.narration: Your XP bar keeps track of your progress. Unlock new tiers as you explore and learn.

beats.onScreen: Feedback widget shown floating in the corner.
beats.narration: Need to report a bug or improve a feature? Use the feedback widget, always ready to listen.

beats.onScreen: Offline-first sync demo: user makes changes without a connection.
beats.narration: Everything happens offline first. Your data writes instantly and syncs in the background. No wallet prompts, no gas fees.

beats.onScreen: Poseidon AI gently closes; Echo waves goodbye in casual mode.
beats.narration: Whether you're here for guidance or company, Aquacellum adapts to you. Start your journey today.
